errors.text: The titanium getter is incorrectly added as 2–5 wt% excess powder within the alloy rather than used externally as titanium sponge, destroying the intended equiatomic composition and potentially creating Ti-rich phases.
The proposed 1300 °C treatment omits the target vacuum sintering regime of 1400 °C for 18 hours and the subsequent water quench from 1500 °C.
The hypothesis requires oxygen below approximately 0.1 wt%, whereas the target process retains approximately 1.0 wt% oxygen for interstitial strengthening while suppressing alpha-HCP formation.
The predicted grain size of 10–20 µm disagrees with the target result of 33 ± 19 µm.
The falsification rule is internally inconsistent: it proposes TiO/TiO2 formation as the gettering mechanism but also treats detection of TiO as falsification.
